name: home_cio_card_settled_actions_20261109
comment: LQ-20261107-1672, Home CIO card. The card's action list filtered stop_advice on the answer only
(RAISE / ADD_STOP / FIX_QTY), so a row the broker's book already satisfies — reconcile_stop_advice
marked it state=done — still rendered as an action and still drove 'Do now n of N'. The operator was
told to raise four stops Schwab already had working. Pins: a done row is not an action and does not
consume a number; quiet rows are not actions either; an unread book is still a decision; a row with no
state field (an old snapshot) is still served as an action, never silently dropped; a card whose every
ask is done renders no actions and no do_now. Synthetic ZQ* fixtures; no store is read.
